_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from cited public records. Statuses and roles are time-bound to source dates; charges are allegations, and reported deaths are not convictions. Public senior figures only; country-level geographic associations; no operational routes, enforcement weaknesses, or unlicensed photos.
